events.event_name: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival
events.brand: New York Transit Museum × MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, Brooklyn Bridge Park, 1 Water Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: The Transit Museum's annual outdoor festival of vintage and historic New York City buses, with boarding, hands-on activities, transit trivia and a scavenger hunt.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, vintage-bus viewing/boarding and advertised festival activities are free.
events.caveats: Official source says advance registration is encouraged but not required. Registration enters visitors in a membership raffle; it is not established as a condition of admission. Event runs rain or shine; equipment is subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–3:30 PM at Emily Warren Roebling Plaza. Children 15 and under must be accompanied by an adult. Vintage buses have stairs and may have boarding lines.

events.event_name: Slow Summer Reading Party with Reading Rhythms
events.address: Liberty Lawn, Pier 6, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: An outdoor social reading party on Liberty Lawn with live music, an hour of reading, one-on-one breakout conversations and group discussion.
events.what_is_free: The reading party and live-music programming are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Brooklyn Bridge Park explicitly says the event is free and open to the public and that RSVPs help with planning. Weather or other extenuating circumstances can change the event.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 1–3 PM on Pier 6 Liberty Lawn. Bring your own book and blanket/towel/yoga mat; chairs are not allowed on the lawn.

occurrences.details: Free public festival; advance registration is encouraged but not required. Runs rain or shine.
Free and open to the public; RSVP is optional and helps organizers plan.
